name: Nikolas Motta
event: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
summary: A Brazilian lightweight brawler (15-6, 1 NC; 3-3, 1 NC UFC; age 34) with real power and a habit of exchanging. He hasn't fought since June 2025, when Nazim Sadykhov stopped him in R2 of a Fight of the Night war that left him with a jaw broken badly enough to need titanium plates. Faces Road to UFC winner Dom Mar Fan in his return.

how_they_fight.Striking: Aggressive, all-in puncher: ten KO/TKO wins, eight in R1, and about 0.9 knockdowns per 15. He dropped Tom Nolan with a right hand and finished him at 1:03 of R1 as an underdog (Cageside), and floored Maheshate twice with left hooks (Cageside). Low accuracy (36%).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Little: no submission wins in our data and almost no takedown offense. Went for a rear-naked choke against Maheshate but couldn't finish (Cageside).
how_they_fight.Defense: The big issue. He absorbs about 5.6 significant strikes a minute with 45% defense. Five of his six losses are knockouts (three in R1, two in R2), including three in the UFC (Jim Miller R2, Manuel Torres R1, Sadykhov R2). Maheshate dropped him with a knee in R1. Takedown defense is decent (about 68%), though Trey Ogden held him down for about 4:28 before their no contest.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Front-loaded. Of ten stoppage wins, eight came in R1, one in R2, one in R3. He rushed Sadykhov in R1 and may have punched himself out (Cageside); he looked tired late against Maheshate but still won R3. Five decision wins, one a four-round fight. Stoppage losses: three in R1, three in R2 (two KOs, one 2013 sub).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Willing to brawl, which brings wins and losses. Opponents who weather the first burst tend to catch him.

patterns: Fast starter: eight of ten stoppage wins in R1
Throws heavy hooks and right hands in exchanges
Fades after an all-out first round
concerns: 17 months out of action after a broken jaw that needed titanium plates
Faces a grappler; Motta has little ground game
keys_to_beat: Survive his opening burst, then make him work in R2-R3
Wrestle and control; he offers little off his back
Body work: Sadykhov broke him down with body shots

news.text: Booked against Dom Mar Fan at UFC Qatar; both are coming off losses. Not yet on the UFC.com event page.
Said his jaw was fractured in the Sadykhov fight and fixed with titanium plates.
Lost to Nazim Sadykhov by R2 TKO (4:17) after a heavy right hand.
